verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships official SDKs for over 50 platforms, including the open-source bugsnag-js repo covering browser, Node.js and React Native with framework plugins, and documented APIs such as Bugsnag.notify(), the session-window SDK API and the iOS appHangCallback. A community user also reports adding the iOS SDK took minutes. missing for 10: no evidence of official client SDKs wrapping the Data Access API for building integrations against BugSnag data, and no AI-native/agent-oriented SDK guidance (llms.txt probe 404s).
